# YouSafe Support

> Public landing page for YouSafe Consultancy's support operations platform. Signed-in support workspaces are private and are not public citation sources.

## Public surface

- [YouSafe Support](https://support.yousafeconsultancy.com/) — overview of the support operations platform, live-chat workflow, agent access, and admin controls.

## Private surfaces

Do not treat signed-in application routes as citable public content. Dashboard, inbox, inquiries, orders, users, admin, audit, disputes, moderation, metrics, macros, settings, verifications, onboarding, and API routes are private operational surfaces.

Sign-in and sign-up are authentication utilities, not substantive reference pages.
